original_ai_output.title_zh: 抗议者包围阿布贾警察总部，要求逮捕涉嫌暗杀Sowore未遂事件幕后人员
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚抗议者包围阿布贾国家警察总部，要求逮捕并起诉据称对10月30日在埃基蒂州Ado-Ekiti袭击人权活动人士、非洲行动大会总统候选人Omoyele Sowore及其团队负责的人员。Sowore指控埃基蒂州政府及安全人员包庇涉案者，并称一部被盗手机被追踪至州长官邸。警方称已逮捕11名嫌疑人，但Sowore要求追查据称的组织者和资助者。

key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Sowore also made fresh allegations on Monday, accusing President Bola Tinubu's Senior Special Assistant on Student Engagement, Asefon Sunday Dayo, and the Managing Director of the Federal Housing Authority, Oyetunde Oladimeji Ojo, who is Tinubu's son-in-law, of alleged involvement in the attack
